patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than Squarespace's shape. Choose Squarespace only if your buying job matches “Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo ” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; Squarespace leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; Squarespace is Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo annual (US 2026 tiles); platform transaction fees .
- Company-size focus: Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market) vs Squarespace (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Squarespace-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Squarespace — Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; Squarespace: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Catalog and B2B depth trail commerce-first platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Squarespace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume · Avoid Lightspeed Retail if you actually need Squarespace's motion (Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanc)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
